name: vsponeblock-mcp
description: Community MCP server for Hitachi VSP One Block: query and manage your storage system through its REST API.
long_description: Gives Claude access to all 425 operations of the Hitachi VSP One Block REST API (Configuration Manager, microcode 10.5.4) through three discovery tools: find an operation, read its parameters, then call it. The server signs in with a storage user and manages its REST API session. It is read-only by default; operations that change the storage system are refused unless you turn on Allow writes. This is a community project, not an official Hitachi Vantara product.

tools.name: vsponeblock_list_operations
tools.description: Search the VSP One Block REST API operations by keyword or tag.

tools.name: vsponeblock_describe_operation
tools.description: Show an operation's parameters and request body schema.

tools.name: vsponeblock_call_operation
tools.description: Call a VSP One Block API operation.

url.title: Storage system URL
url.description: Address of the REST API server, e.g. https://192.0.2.10 (the SVP, or the controller for VSP One Block 20 series). /ConfigurationManager is added for you.

user.title: User name
user.description: Storage system user. Use a user with only the roles you need, e.g. Storage Administrator (View Only) for read-only use.

toolsets.title: Direct toolsets
toolsets.description: Optional. Comma-separated API areas (tags) to expose as direct tools, e.g. simple/volumes,simple/pools

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Allow operations that change state. Leave off for read-only access.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Optional. PEM file of the CA that signed the VSP One Block certificate

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Accept any certificate. For labs with self-signed certificates only.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Where downloaded files are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads/vsponeblock-mcp

upload_dir.title: Upload folder
upload_dir.description: Optional. The only folder files (certificates, encryption key backups) may be uploaded from. Uploads are write operations, so they also need Allow writes.
